name: New Mexico
permitAge: 15, if enrolled in or finished an approved driver education course with a DWI prevention component

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, certified in writing by a parent or guardian
teen.holdPermit: 6 months, plus 30 days for each traffic violation on the permit
teen.nightLimit: Provisional license: no driving midnight to 5 a.m. unless with a licensed driver 21 or older, or for family/medical necessity, work, school, religious or emergency reasons
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional license: no more than one passenger under 21 who is not immediate family, unless a licensed driver 21 or older is in the vehicle
teen.phone: Texting while driving prohibited for all drivers (NMSA 66-7-374; fine listed $25 first offense in a 2016 fiscal note). A teen-specific all-device ban was in a 2013 bill; enactment not confirmed.

notes: Instruction permit supervisor: licensed driver 21 or older, licensed at least three years (NM or another state), in the seat beside the driver (MVD Chapter 3).
Provisional license held at least 12 months before a full license, plus 30 days per conviction (MVD Chapter 4).

Written test: 70 percent or better; offered in English, Spanish, Tagalog, Italian, German, French, Vietnamese and Chinese (older MVD manual page). Not required with a current out-of-state license. Third-party sites say 25 questions, 18 to pass; not confirmed by MVD.
School bus: stop on either side of the road; no stop needed when the bus is coming toward you and a median or physical barrier separates the roadways (NM driver manual).
Move over (66-7-332.1): exact current wording not confirmed; NMDOT says change lanes or slow down. Not used in questions.
Spanish driver manual exists (MVD manuals page lists "En Espanol Driver's Manual"); direct PDF URL not confirmed, so handbook.es is null.
WebFetch to state sites blocked; facts are from search-result summaries of the pages listed.
